excluded_from_review: Data entitlement, point-in-time availability, adjustment basis, distributions, NAV/IOPV, execution, capacity, product diligence, suitability, allocation and order decisions.
Any assertion that the four-ETF observation is an open U0 universe, total-return replay or usable strategy.

research_only_classification.reason: The repaired artifacts pass the narrow audit of disclosed monthly self-financing arithmetic, drift-based turnover, annual carry-forward, sealed-source verification and source-path independence disclosure. This is not a pass for a strategy, product, allocation, holding, cash-receipt objective, dividend-reinvestment objective, total-return replay or execution.

accounting_cash_boundary.meaning: cash is only the accounting cash leg and residual portfolio weight inside the self-financing simulation.

source_integrity.boundary: The controls are case-local hash checks. Their explicit post-capture migration status does not establish external notarization, entitlement, point-in-time availability, total return or execution quality.

verified_checks.evidence: Independent reconstruction from frozen open/close records matched all H01-H07 monthly ledgers: first observed session of each eligible calendar month uses closes only through the prior observed session, then executes at the next observed session open. Event counts are H01=144, H02=144, H03=144, H04=147, H05=138, H06=144, H07=144.

verified_checks.check: Units, accounting cash leg, drift and one-way turnover
verified_checks.evidence: Independent replay over public and SSE raw panels matched all 7 hypotheses x 4 cost sensitivities. Between monthly events units and accounting cash remain unchanged; close values drift with observed closes; rebalance turnover is computed from drifted pre-trade securities plus cash weights to targets. Every first rebalance has one_way_turnover=1.0.

For all 56 replay paths, independently recomputed pre-trade open NAV minus stated cost equals post-trade open NAV. Maximum disclosed absolute self-financing error is at most 4.440892098500626e-16. Annual rows use prior-session NAV; initial and cutoff calendar fragments are flagged incomplete and included_in_any_annual_hurdle=false.

verified_checks.check: Daily-state retention is compact without losing auditability
verified_checks.evidence: H01/20 bps retains 2,903 daily units/cash/close-NAV states in cost_sensitivity only. primary_20bps is the same path with daily_position_state removed. H02-H07 retain complete monthly rebalance ledgers for all stated cost sensitivities, which were independently replayed.

verified_checks.check: Sealed source, manifest dependency and registry verification
verified_checks.evidence: P02/P03 raw file hashes, source_freeze entries, manifest file entries, dependency records and source_registry sealed_manifest_sha256 records all matched. The scripts enforce these checks in public lines 324-374 and SSE lines 269-326.

verified_checks.check: verify-only is non-mutating for reviewed case artifacts
verified_checks.evidence: Both scripts completed verify-only with PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1. Before/after SHA-256 values of each source manifest, source manifest Markdown, derived JSON/Markdown and source_registry were identical. Public derived JSON SHA-256=7da423204daae0a3a33242cab5895241526f02ed33026ca2ebe5c553bcf63cb5; SSE derived JSON SHA-256=4db6e56aea46c78b6529e1ca8d78460741cc3d2d1466db97e3c0855742e15c7e.

Static branch review confirms that after sealed-source loading, refresh-derived writes only derived JSON/Markdown and contains no manifest write: public lines 1012-1017, SSE lines 675-680. It was not executed because this audit was authorized to change only audit artifacts.

verified_checks.check: SSE is labeled source-path triangulation, not an independent model
verified_checks.evidence: SSE imports the public model and calls public_screen._market_panels, _build_rebalance_schedule and _evaluate at SSE lines 27, 448, 451 and 456. Its Markdown and JSON explicitly state that common calculation functions prevent independent model validation.

verified_checks.check: Current derived outputs reproduce from their sealed input and checked scripts
verified_checks.evidence: Current public _result and SSE _screen payloads each exactly matched the stored JSON after sealed-source validation; no output divergence was observed.

findings.closure_evidence: Monthly self-financing units-and-accounting-cash model is independently replayed for both source paths and all 7 x 4 cost paths; drifted component-weight turnover and cost reconciliation match the stored ledgers.
Annual arithmetic carries the prior observed-session NAV and excludes incomplete boundary years from a separate annual hurdle.
Manifest raw/dependency hashes and P02/P03 registry seals are verified before calculation; verify-only was observed not to alter reviewed case artifacts; refresh-derived contains no manifest write.
Both descriptive overlap inputs are now recorded as hash-bound dependencies with explicit descriptive-only roles and verified at runtime.
Protocol now calls the exercise exploratory and not independently pre-registered, and specifies the full-lookback monthly-boundary warm-up rule.
Both outputs retain all-date, per-asset present/unknown source-state rows and common-valid-observation flags.

residual_limitations_not_defects_in_this: Public historical prices are not entitled point-in-time total-return or execution data.
The observation covers four comparison ETFs only and is not an open U0 or approved decision universe.
SSE triangulates publisher path only because its accounting model is intentionally shared with P02.
Rolling five-year public-price windows overlap and cannot establish independent performance evidence.
A case-local post-capture hash seal does not prove original capture-time provenance.

required_status_after_audit.allowed_conclusion: The R2 public-price research screen has passed this limited accounting and integrity re-audit.
prohibited_conclusions: cash receipt, dividend or reinvestment objective achieved
